$comment: Copy this file to ~/.dsh/model-auto-router.json to activate dsh-model-auto-router. Every field is optional; without pools the plugin stays out of the way.
$comment_routes: A provider is a route registered with the host's llm service, and a model is whatever that provider's adapter dispatches — neither is free-form. The settings page (Settings -> Model Router) lists the routes this host actually has and suggests their models, so prefer editing there. The names below are examples.
$comment_main: The main (root) agent draws from this pool.
$comment_subagent: Subagents draw from this pool. Omit it, or set inheritMain to false, to leave delegation on DSH's own model.
$comment_fallback: Last-resort routes, tried when the agent's own pool has no healthy candidate left.

health.$comment_threshold: Consecutive unavailable failures before a route is demoted. 1 = switch on the first error.
health.$comment_cooldown: How long a demoted route is skipped before it is retried.
